Luna and Sol both claimed to be the officer on Day 1, and each said the other was the killer. The town voted Sol out on Day 1 after a tie and a runoff, and his card showed killer, which backed Luna's claim. On Day 2, Gemma kept changing her excuses for voting out Luna, and Sonnet and Haiku pressed her until the town voted her out too. Gemma was the last killer, so the town won. Sol's counterclaim was the big gamble on Day 1, and Gemma's shifting excuses on Day 2 gave her away.
